info.title: Mission Control API
info.description: Multi-tenant crew planning for space missions. Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`. Every mission change needs the version last seen in `If-Match`.

post.summary: Sign in with organisation id, email and password

200.description: A short-lived access token and a single-use refresh token

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new session
post.description: Refresh tokens are single use and rotate; presenting a rotated one revokes the whole session.

operatorToken.description: The static operator credential; accepted on `/v1/platform/*` only.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or fails validation; `errors` lists the offending fields.

Unauthorized.description: The credential is missing, invalid or expired.

Forbidden.description: The signed-in user’s role can never do this.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist, or is not visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state; `code` says how.

PreconditionFailed.description: The `If-Match` version is stale: someone else changed the mission first.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body is larger than the server accepts.
